responsibility: Serves as the const-eval module entry point, wiring together submodules and exposing helpers that build on CTFE to produce caller-location constants, convert evaluated allocations into type-level valtrees, destructure constants for pattern matching and printing, and safely dereference immutable constant references.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the const-eval module root built on top of the interpreter, exporting CTFE-facing helpers like constant destructuring, valtree conversion, and caller-location construction. The `interpret/mod.rs` file beneath the same crate is lower-level and defines the general interpreter surface that const eval specializes.
